alt: AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on colorful cushioned seating overlooking pastel coastal buildings and a church tower. A blonde woman in a navy mini hugs a seated braided woman in a coral mini from behind. The seated woman clasps hands with a woman in a pearl top and turquoise mini, while a fourth stands in a Croatian-flag outfit. Rainbow legwear, coral boots, metallic RAZE pumps and arm tattoos vary across the group. Distant fires, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary scenery, not a real disaster.
